title: Endometrium Dissociation with Collagenase
author: Roser Vento-Tormo
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.76thren
materials: Tighten lid and then seal with parafilm.

steps.title: Prepare tissue and optional preservation
steps.instruction: If needed, flash‑freeze tissue in isopentane for spatial transcriptomics; for transport, place tissue in HypoThermosol® FRS at 4 °C; store samples for formalin fixation (RNA Scope) or flash‑freeze for nuclei sequencing. Scrape off visible blood vessels (skip if donor was perfused).

steps.title: Mince tissue
steps.instruction: Place wet tissue under a petri dish and use two scalpels to roughly mince the tissue to increase digestion efficiency.

steps.title: Add collagenase mix
steps.instruction: Transfer the minced tissue to a 50 mL Falcon tube containing the collagenase mix (approximately 3 mL per tissue piece; adjust volume according to tissue size).

steps.title: Digest tissue
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube at 37 °C for 45 minutes with shaking (shaking is recommended).

steps.title: Dilute digestion
steps.instruction: Resuspend the digested tissue with 20 mL RPMI 10 % (RPMI supplemented with 10 % serum).

steps.title: Filter suspension
steps.instruction: Pass the suspension through a 100 µm cell strainer; do not discard the retained tissue, which will be used later for the “Endometrium‑Trypsin” protocol.

steps.title: Centrifuge filtrate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the filtrate at 450 g (0.5 rcf) for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Wash pellet
steps.instruction: Wash the cell pellet twice with 10 mL PBS each time.

steps.title: Resuspend for counting
steps.instruction: Resuspend the washed pellet in 1 mL RPMI 10 %, count the cells, and sort the desired population according to the “Cell staining for flow cytometry and sorting” protocol.

steps.title: Optional RBC lysis (biopsies)
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell suspension in 2–4 mL 1X RBC lysis buffer and incubate for 10 minutes. Prepare 1X RBC lysis buffer by diluting the 10X stock with water. After lysis, add 10 mL RPMI 10 %, centrifuge at 450 g for 5 minutes, and wash twice with 10 mL PBS.

steps.title: Optional freezing
steps.instruction: Resuspend cells in freezing medium to a concentration of 1 × 10⁷ cells/mL and aliquot into cryogenic storage vials.
